description_en: Queries the asset management properties and current processing status. For upload, rebuild, and chunk content editing operations, poll the status of this API until it returns COMPLETED or FAILED. For failure causes, refer to lastError. The publishedResultAvailable field indicates whether the published result is still available. This API does not accept clientToken and does not return receipts for chunkUpdate or historical modifications. If a deletion request is accepted, the API returns a resource not found error
description_zh: 查询资产管理属性及当前处理状态。上传、重建、Chunk 正文编辑均轮询本接口的 status，直到 COMPLETED 或 FAILED，失败原因见 lastError；publishedResultAvailable 表示已发布结果是否仍可用。不接收 clientToken，不返回 chunkUpdate 或某次历史修改的回执；删除受理后返回资源不存在
name: GetAsset

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AgentCore workspace. Magic resolves the tenantId from the trusted gateway call identity and verifies workspace ownership. Knowledge bases are created or accessed within this tenant and workspace. Cross-tenant queries cannot be performed by using only knowledgeBaseId
parameters.help_zh: 由 Magic 从可信网关调用身份解析 tenantId 并校验工作空间归属；知识库在该租户及工作空间内创建或访问，不能仅凭 knowledgeBaseId 跨租户查询
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the knowledge base to which the asset belongs
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

parameters.help_en: The stable identifier of the asset to be queried
parameters.help_zh: 待查询资产的稳定标识
parameters.name: asset_id

data.description_en: The asset management properties, original file name, source, number of chunks, metadata, asset-level chunking configuration snapshot, and the current status, lastError, and publishedResultAvailable. This does not include chunkUpdate or clientToken
data.description_zh: 资产管理属性、原件文件名、来源、切片数量、元数据、资产级分块配置快照及当前 status、lastError、publishedResultAvailable；不包含 chunkUpdate 或 clientToken

assetId.description_en: The stable ID of the asset. You can specify this ID when creating an asset. If assetId is not specified but clientToken is provided, the platform stably derives the ID based on the resource scope and clientToken. If neither is provided, a new asset is created for each request. Setting overwrite=true registers a new upload session for the same asset, and the previously published version remains in use until the new result is published
assetId.description_zh: 资产的稳定 ID。新建时可指定；未指定 assetId 但提供 clientToken 时由平台按资源范围和 clientToken 稳定派生，两者均未提供时每次请求创建新资产。overwrite=true 可以为同一资产登记新的上传会话，新结果发布前继续使用旧发布版本

chunkConfiguration.description_en: The effective chunking configuration used for processing this asset. Explicitly uploaded configurations take precedence over the knowledge base default values. Subsequent modifications to the knowledge base configuration do not change this snapshot
chunkConfiguration.description_zh: 本次资产处理使用的有效分块配置。上传显式配置优先于知识库默认值；后续知识库配置修改不改变该快照

headingLevel.description_en: Required when the strategy is BY_HEADING. The value ranges from 1 to 6. Headings at or above this level are used as boundaries. Deeper headings are retained in the body text. Overlong sections fall back to paragraph or sentence splitting. Documents without headings fall back to intelligent splitting. This parameter is ignored for other strategies and is validated by the backend based on the strategy
headingLevel.description_zh: BY_HEADING 下必填且范围为 1 至 6。小于等于此级数的标题均作为边界；更深标题保留在正文，超长节按段落或句子回退，无标题文档退化为智能切分。其他策略忽略，由后端按策略校验

maxChunkSize.description_en: The value ranges from 1 to 6000 characters. It follows the character length metric of EB and is not the number of tokens. If omitted, the server-side default value is used
maxChunkSize.description_zh: 1 至 6000 字符，沿用 EB 的字符长度口径，不是 Token 数；省略使用服务端默认值

overlapSize.description_en: Effective only when the strategy is BY_LENGTH. The unit is characters, and the default value is 0. The valid value must be greater than or equal to 0 and less than the effective maxChunkSize. The total length after overlapping must not exceed the maximum chunk size. This parameter is ignored for other strategies and is validated by the backend based on the strategy
overlapSize.description_zh: 仅 BY_LENGTH 生效，单位为字符，缺省为 0；有效值须大于等于 0 且小于有效 maxChunkSize，重叠后仍不超过最大分块长度。其他策略忽略，由后端按策略校验

preprocessRules.description_en: The text preprocessing rules applied before splitting
preprocessRules.description_zh: 切分前的文本预处理规则

removeUrlsAndEmails.description_en: Specifies whether to remove URLs and email addresses during parsing
removeUrlsAndEmails.description_zh: 是否在解析时删除 URL 和邮箱地址

replaceConsecutiveWhitespace.description_en: Specifies whether to replace consecutive spaces, line breaks, and tabs with a single space
replaceConsecutiveWhitespace.description_zh: 是否将连续空格、换行、制表符替换为单个空格

separator.description_en: Required and non-empty when the strategy is BY_SEPARATOR. It matches the literal string as a whole and does not use regular expressions. This parameter is ignored for other strategies
separator.description_zh: BY_SEPARATOR 下必填且非空，按字面字符串整体匹配，不使用正则；其他策略忽略

strategy.description_en: The saved chunking strategy. AUTO indicates automatic chunking, and BY_SEPARATOR indicates chunking by separator. BY_LENGTH and BY_HEADING are returned only for backward compatibility with historical configurations. Only AUTO and BY_SEPARATOR are accepted when creating or updating configurations in the current phase
strategy.description_zh: 返回已保存的分块策略。AUTO 为自动分块，BY_SEPARATOR 为分隔符分块；BY_LENGTH 和 BY_HEADING 仅为历史配置兼容返回，新建或更新配置时一期仅接受 AUTO 和 BY_SEPARATOR

chunkCount.description_en: The total number of chunks in the currently published result. This value is 0 before the first publication. During re-chunking or editing, it still counts the published result
chunkCount.description_zh: 当前已发布结果的 Chunk 总数，首次发布前为 0；重新分块或编辑处理中仍统计已发布结果

contentType.description_en: The MIME type of the uploaded original file for this asset
contentType.description_zh: 该资产上传原件的 MIME 类型

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 UTC format

enabled.description_en: Specifies whether the asset is enabled. If disabled, the asset is excluded from regular viewing, retrieval, and downloading. Management APIs remain subject to management permissions
enabled.description_zh: 禁用后不参与普通查看、检索和下载；管理接口仍受管理权限控制

fileName.description_en: The file name of the currently uploaded original file. Modifying the display name does not change this value
fileName.description_zh: 当前上传原件的文件名；修改显示名称不改变此值

knowledgeBaseId.description_en: The ID of the knowledge base to which the asset belongs

lastError.description_en: The redacted error of the current upload or processing. It does not contain internal credentials, paths, or run identifiers
lastError.description_zh: 当前上传或处理的脱敏错误；不含内部凭据、路径和运行标识

code.description_en: The stable product error code. It does not return internal task identifiers, stacks, or storage addresses
code.description_zh: 稳定的产品错误码；不返回内部任务标识、堆栈或存储地址

message.description_en: The redacted error summary that can be displayed to users
message.description_zh: 可向用户展示的脱敏错误摘要

metadata.description_en: The complete list of effective metadata key-value pairs, including constants and system variable results. Patches involving retrieval projection do not overwrite old effective values before the new result is published
metadata.description_zh: 已生效的完整元数据键值列表，含常量和系统变量结果；涉及检索投影的补丁在新结果发布前不覆盖旧生效值

key.description_en: The field name declared in metadataSchema. It must not be duplicated in the same request. Fixed value and system variable fields are generated by the server and do not accept customer overrides
key.description_zh: metadataSchema 中声明的字段名；同一请求中不得重复。固定值及系统变量字段由服务端生成，不接受客户覆盖

value.description_en: The string parsed according to the schema type. If omitted or null during upload, no value is assigned and the value is populated by the schema. In the UpdateAsset operation, omitting the field, specifying a null value, or providing an empty string deletes the key. Unsubmitted keys remain unchanged. The DATETIME type accepts ISO 8601 with a time zone, yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, or yyyy-MM-dd
value.description_zh: 按 schema 类型解析的字符串。上传时省略或空值表示未赋值，由 schema 填充；UpdateAsset 中省略、null 或空串表示删除该 key，未提交的 key 保持不变。DATETIME 接受 ISO 8601 含时区、yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss 或 yyyy-MM-dd

name.description_en: The default name is the uploaded file name. You can modify the display name by calling UpdateAsset
name.description_zh: 默认采用上传文件名，可通过 UpdateAsset 修改显示名称

publishedResultAvailable.description_en: Indicates whether the published result is available. The value is true if a published version exists and the asset is neither disabled nor deleted. The value may still be true if re-chunking or editing fails, and is false if the first processing fails
publishedResultAvailable.description_zh: 已发布版本存在且资产未禁用、未删除时为 true；重新分块或编辑失败时可能仍为 true，首次处理失败时为 false

sizeBytes.description_en: The size of the current original file in bytes. This value is not returned before the upload is confirmed. After confirmation, the actual size verified by the OSS HEAD request is returned
sizeBytes.description_zh: 当前原件字节数；上传确认前不返回，确认后返回经 OSS HEAD 校验的实际大小

sourceModifiedTime.description_en: The last modification time of the source file in UTC epoch milliseconds. This value is not returned if it is not provided
sourceModifiedTime.description_zh: 源文件最后修改时间，UTC epoch 毫秒；未提供时不返回

sourceType.description_en: The import channel of the asset, such as UPLOAD or OSS. This is recorded by the platform based on the trusted access path and is not used to grant access permissions
sourceType.description_zh: 资产导入渠道，如 UPLOAD、OSS；由平台根据可信接入路径记录，不用于授予访问权限

sourceUri.description_en: The URI of the original source. This is used only for tracing. It does not grant download authorization and does not trigger server-side fetching
sourceUri.description_zh: 原件来源的 URI，仅用于溯源，不是下载授权，也不触发服务端抓取

status.description_en: The current upload or processing status of the document. Upload, rebuild, and chunk body editing are all polled through GetAsset. PENDING indicates waiting for processing, PROCESSING indicates processing in progress, COMPLETED indicates that publication is finished, and FAILED indicates final failure and returns lastError. This does not represent the result of a specific historical request. No readable result is available if the first processing fails. During overwrite upload, rebuild, or editing, and after failure, the published result remains readable if the enabled and deletion statuses allow it
status.description_zh: 文档当前上传或处理状态。上传、重建和 Chunk 正文编辑均通过 GetAsset 轮询；PENDING 为等待处理，PROCESSING 为正在处理，完成发布后为 COMPLETED，最终失败为 FAILED 并返回 lastError。不表示某次历史请求的结果。首次处理失败没有可读结果；覆盖上传、重建或编辑期间以及失败后，已发布结果在启用和删除状态允许时仍可读

updatedAt.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 UTC format

workspaceId.description_en: The workspace to which the asset belongs

message.description_en: The description of the redacted result

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
